title: Mean time to triage — phishing report
summary: Time between a phishing-triage playbook run starting and the case being closed via one of the terminal branches — either suppress-and-close in the suppression branch or one of the intent-routed response actions. Measures responsiveness of the triage workflow itself, independent of any downstream response-playbook duration.

target.rationale: Operator target for business-hours phishing triage SLA.

measurement.formula: mean( terminal_step.completed_at - start.completed_at ) over phishing-triage runs in window. Terminal step is the suppression close, any intent-routed response, or the manual-review route — whichever was reached.

inputs.name: playbook_run
inputs.description: wall-clock duration from workflow start to the end step
